problem_type: Locale-generated conversation names rejected by ASCII/Han-only validation
symptom: Korean browser new conversation 새 대화2 fails agent_lane_execute_failed before native OpenCode can run.
direct_cause: LANE_NAME_SHAPE only accepts ASCII letters/numbers and a partial Han range.
class_root: Safe path components are incorrectly defined by language-specific character ranges instead of Unicode character roles.
affected_population: Japanese, Cyrillic, Arabic and combining-mark user conversation names
invariants: Names keep exact original spelling and Unicode normalization form.
Names begin with a Unicode letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, combining marks, ASCII space, underscore and hyphen.
Names remain 1-64 Unicode code points; separators, controls and punctuation are rejected.

door_reduction.why_not: Three lane commands share the parser and that parser reads one character-role shape; neither entry is a bypass.

generality_proof: Unicode letter/number/mark roles cover any writing system without provider, locale or script branches. Path characters remain excluded and names are not normalized or trimmed.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate all lane-create/select/delete names before either host mutates session state.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls parseLaneCommand which routes all three lane commands to parseLaneName.
Calls parseLaneCommand before runtime command dispatch.

recurrence.reason: Every localized Korean fresh conversation and equivalent user-language name can enter the same command parser.
same_class_scan: Read laneSessionCwd and session identity storage: exact names are identity, no normalization permitted.

prevention.invariant: Names begin with a Unicode letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, combining marks, ASCII space, underscore and hyphen.
prevention.failure_mode: LaneCommandError rejects unsafe components before persistence.
prevention.strategy: Replace language-specific alphabet ranges with Unicode character properties at the existing shared parser.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove ASCII/Han-only alphabet and Chinese-specific error wording; no second parser is introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No runtime dependency owns this internal instruction conflict; use native agent translation and existing user-visible prompt review.

migration: Existing transcript names remain byte-for-byte unchanged. New accepted names are validated without normalization or trimming.
residual_risks: Real browser new conversation and native engine execution need rerun after server rebuild.
internal_only_reason: An internal command/path safety invariant; no external dependency controls lane name validation.
